messages.businessImpact: Local administrator passwords are unmanaged, which in most estates means they are the same on every device. One recovered password becomes administrative access everywhere.
remediation: Create a Local admin password solution policy under Endpoint security, Account protection.
Back up passwords to Entra ID and rotate them automatically.
messages.cannotSee: Whether a Settings Catalog policy configures LAPS is read from its settings. Until that mapping is verified against a tenant this rule reports nothing rather than reporting every tenant as missing LAPS. A legacy Account protection intent is not counted because its template subtype does not say whether its settings configure LAPS.
